title: IANN: A Unified Framework for Equivariant InterAtomic Neural Networks with User-Friendly Implementation
abstract: arXiv:2611.19793v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Machine-learning interatomic potentials (MLIPs) now approach density functional theory (DFT) accuracy at a fraction of its cost, but the practical benefit is limited by software fragmentation: each state-of-the-art architecture is released as a separate codebase, with its own data format, configuration system, training loop and molecular-dynamics interface. Comparing two architectures on the same dataset, or moving a trained model into a production simulation, therefore requires substantial re-engineering. We introduce IANN (InterAtomic Neural Network), an open-source PyTorch framework that reimplements equivariant graph neural networks - PaiNN, NequIP, MACE, Allegro, EquiformerV2, EquiformerV3 and UMA - behind a unified data object, a unified trainer and a single deployment route, so that the architecture is a one-word change in a configuration dictionary. translated_title: IANN：具有用户友好实现的等变原子间神经网络统一框架
translated_abstract: 机器学习原子间势（MLIP）如今能够以极低的计算成本逼近密度泛函理论（DFT）的精度，但其实际应用价值却受到软件碎片化的限制：每个最先进的架构都以独立的代码库发布，各自拥有不同的数据格式、配置系统、训练循环和分子动力学接口。因此，在同一数据集上比较两种架构，或将训练好的模型迁移到生产级模拟中，都需要大量的重新开发工作。我们提出了 IANN（InterAtomic Neural Network，原子间神经网络），这是一个开源的 PyTorch 框架，它在统一的数据对象、统一的训练器和单一的部署路径之下重新实现了多种等变图神经网络——包括 PaiNN、NequIP、MACE、Allegro、EquiformerV2、EquiformerV3 和 UMA——使得切换架构只需在配置字典中修改一个单词。对于每一种架构，力、应力和维里量都可以通过同一个解析……（摘要在此处截断）
tldr: IANN 是一个开源 PyTorch 统一框架，将 PaiNN、NequIP、MACE、Allegro 等多种等变图神经网络架构整合在统一的数据对象、训练器和部署流程之下，使切换架构只需修改配置中的一个词，解决了机器学习原子间势领域的软件碎片化问题。
en_tdlr: IANN is an open-source PyTorch framework that unifies multiple equivariant graph neural network architectures (PaiNN, NequIP, MACE, Allegro, EquiformerV2/V3, UMA) behind a single data object, trainer and deployment route, reducing architecture switching to a one-word configuration change and solving software fragmentation in machine-learning interatomic potentials.
